description.value: Two Parrots is a bar and grill on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, operating seven days a week including statutory holidays. Situated in the heart of Vancouver's entertainment district, it offers both a food menu and drinks specials in an indoor-only setting. A touring cyclist finishing a ride into the city would find it a convenient stop for a meal and drinks in a central location.
